system.description: The simple directional force field can now be expanded and broadened into a force barrier, similar to that generated by energy shield technology. The intensity of the barrier, as well as its shape and position, can be modulated by the psychic to allow for air flow, letting friends in while keeping foes out, and directing attacks to the outside of the barrier. The maximum armor rating for a FarWall is 10d+victory points; the minimum amount of damage which will activate the FarWall is equal to the psychic’s Urge.
